test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_adversarial_review.py tests/test_causal_hypothesis.py tests/test_evidence_labels.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/research/adversarial_review.py tests/test_adversarial_review.py

implemented: Requires review findings, rationale, and evidence IDs for leakage, costs, multiple testing, chance fitting, and falsifier quality.
Requires author-distinct reviewer identity and a trusted receipt over the exact review contents before registration for approval.
Derives REJECTED, NEEDS_REVISION, or APPROVED from findings and receipt status; missing or late receipts cannot approve.
Stores review outcomes append-only and immutably and never mutates paper strategy state.
blockers: No approved internal identity provider or deployment-pinned reviewer trust roots are configured.
Review archive is not integrated with the hypothesis, trial registration, or production paper workflow.
Unit-test signatures are synthetic and do not constitute an independent human review.
